title: Find All Nodes at Distance K from a Target Node
problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree, a target node, and an integer K, determine all nodes whose shortest distance from the target node is exactly K edges.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains the target node value and the integer K.
output: • Print the values of all qualifying nodes in the required order.
